claim: File sync and share platform; delivered as a single binary or container from Raspberry Pi to Kubernetes
Clients: Web, Android, iOS, Desktop; WebDAV and CS3 APIs; web client developed in this repository
OpenID Connect with Keycloak or embedded LibreGraph Connect
Office apps: Collabora Online, OnlyOffice Docs, Microsoft Office Online Server via WOPI gateway
Some builds of stable releases from ownCloud GmbH are subject to an EULA
Quickstart uses init --insecure yes and OCIS_INSECURE=true
